subject: Cascadia proof-of-fit plan & success checkpoints
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@cascadiahealth.com>, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@cascadiahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@cascadiahealth.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cascadia proof-of-fit — proposed plan

Hi Elena / Arjun —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Per our conversation, I pulled together a concise proof-of-fit (POF) plan that focuses on the two use cases you flagged (document ingestion + query latency under realistic traffic). The attached runbook is a working draft, but the core ask here is to align on: success criteria, timeline, owners, and weekly check-ins so we can kick off next week if Cascadia is ready.

High-level proposed success criteria (for alignment):
- Functional: 95% accurate retrieval of policy documents based on our provided evaluation set (precision@5)
- Latency: median response under 350ms for 512-token queries at a 2 RPS sustained burst
- Reliability: system stable across 8-hour validation window with <1% error rate
- Data controls: logs retained per your policy; KV cache not persisted beyond session (we'll provide a design note)

Proposed timeline (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff): environment access, test data handoff, success criteria sign-off
- Week 1: ingestion + mapping, baseline metrics collection
- Week 2: optimization (batching/quantization config), mid-point review
- Week 3: validation run, readout prep
- Week 4: final readout + decision gate

Owners (Redwood):
- Vanessa Ortiz — engagement lead / commercial 
- Marcus Lin — solutions engineer (technical lead)
- Grace O’Connor — customer success (post-POC onboarding)

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm that the listed success criteria match Cascadia’s buyer and technical expectations
2) Share any additional evaluation data sets or compliance constraints (data retention, on-prem requirements) by EOD Monday 5/24
3) Confirm kickoff slot: Tue 5/25 or Wed 5/26 (we can accommodate morning PST)

Attachments: Cascadia-POC-Runbook-v1.pdf (draft), Cascadia-SOW-draft.docx (commercial draft).

If this looks ok, I’ll get Marcus to add a light-weight validation checklist and we’ll lock the kickoff.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cascadia proof-of-fit — proposed plan

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear recap and the runbook. A few clarifications from our side before we sign off:

1) Success criteria: the accuracy metric is directionally correct. Can we add an evaluation split that includes a set of 150 red-team examples (medical policy variations) to ensure recall on edge cases?
2) Latency: 350ms median is fine, but our procurement will want the 95th percentile under a 5 RPS spike documented in the readout. Can Redwood run a short stress pass during Week 3?
3) Data retention: we must retain only minimal logs for 30 days and ensure logs exclude PHI. Can you include a short note in the runbook about log scrubbing and retention windows?

On timing — procurement wants the engagement start no earlier than 5/26 (we need internal legal to clear the SOW). We should plan a kickoff Wed 5/26 at 10:00 AM PST if that works for your team.

I’ve looped in procurement for SOW steps.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Clinical Systems | Cascadia Health
eruiz@cascadiahealth.com

Elena / Vanessa —

Thanks for the notes — quick technical response and a proposed lightweight validation checklist I’ll own during the run: 

Checklist (Marcus — technical lead):
- Access: secure S3 read-only (or secure share) for the evaluation set; service account + temp creds by Day 0
- Data prep: sample red-team set (150 examples) — we’ll keep test set separate and immutable
- Baseline: run baseline model (open checkpoint) to establish v0 metrics by Day 3
- Stress pass: synthetic 5 RPS spike during Week 3 (30 minutes) capturing p50/p95/p99
- Privacy: implement log filter stage prior to storage (we will provide scrub regex patterns)

Proposed owners & contacts: 
- Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com) — technical lead, runs Week 1–3 validations
- Grace O’Connor (grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com) — CS lead for onboarding acceptance and post-POC plan
- Vanessa Ortiz — commercial lead / decision owner

Next: Vanessa — if you can confirm kickoff on Wed 5/26 10:00 AM PST, I’ll circulate a 30-minute kickoff agenda (access checklist + validation schedule). Also, can Cascadia share the red-team file by COB Tuesday 5/25?

— Marcus
